{{unknown name}} [[File:CTV News Crew M03.png|thumb|250px|The CTV news crew]] The '''CTV news crew''' are a pair of minor characters who appeared in ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. The {{tc|reporter}} and her supporting {{tc|cameraman}} work for a news corporation called CTV. ==In animation== The news crew traveled to [[Greenfield]] to report on the crystallization phenomenon that was spreading from the [[Spencer Hale|Hale mansion]] and enveloping the rest of the surrounding area. They captured footage of {{OBP|Entei|M03}} kidnapping {{Delia|Ash's mother}} and later as {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} attempted to enter the Hale mansion. The coverage kept [[Schuyler]], {{OBP|Lisa|M03}}, and {{an|Professor Oak}} informed while they waited inside the local [[Pokémon Center]]. Their footage also alerted [[Ash's Charizard]] to the crisis, and it flew to the Hale mansion from the [[Charicific Valley]] to assist Ash. The reporter and cameraman continued reporting, but they were kept away from much of the action by the crystalline matrix. After Entei helped destroy the {{OBP|Unown|M03}} and the crystallization subsequently receded, the news crew and their van were part of a car convoy that traveled to the Hale mansion to retrieve Ash and the others. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja='''Reporter''': 沢海陽子 ''[[Yōko Sōmi]]''
